text.content:
Juiced, framed out, and living for the next fight.

Turf: Wherever a pack has a gym: Wellsprings, Arroyo, West Wind and anywhere with fight nights
Known for: Blunt weapons, steroids and muscle augs, Frames and Grafted Muscle, MMA training; trial by combat
Leadership: A council of pack alphas
Allies & rivals: Whoever messes with a pack's turf. Patrons of the Muses
Hangouts: The Slammer's Friday fight nights (#66), the Beach Club in West Wind, underground gyms citywide

A street-fighting gang that sprang up in the late 2060s, when a handful of small cyber fight clubs came together. A council of pack alphas decides its direction between them. The members are huge, chromed with Frames and Grafted Muscle, juiced with tailored hormones and steroids, and they go by animal names. They settle every dispute, even among themselves, by fighting it out.

The chrome and the drugs aren't cheap, so the Animals aren't above the usual gang business: hiring out as muscle, running underground death matches and raiding other people's stashes. But they respect anyone who can put up a good fight.

Packs

  • The Slammer, Wellsprings. Alpha Tusk runs its Friday fight nights.
  • The Sharks, West Wind. Big Mako's pack turned a members' beach club into a gym, with fight nights by the empty pool.
  • Xanadu, North Heywood. The Muses' roller-derby track counts as a pack gym, and derby nights double as fight nights.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.25; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 10, 12
